definitions.explanation: A retail establishment where goods are sold. Can refer to any type of shop.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{何時|なんじ}まで{開|あ}いていますか？
examples.english: Until what time is this store open?

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}ができました。
examples.english: A new store opened near the station.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}のラーメンはおいしいです。
examples.english: The ramen at that shop is delicious.

notes: A general word for shops of all kinds. Specific types: {本屋|ほんや} (bookstore), {花屋|はなや} (flower shop), {八百屋|やおや} (greengrocer). お{店|みせ} is the polite form.
